messages:
Maria: Quick heads-up — kicking off a compact access review cycle next week. Goal: reduce admin blast radius + remediate ownerless service roles.
Aj: I'm in for svc-key owners. Can we pull KMS usage logs for 90 days to validate usage?
Samir: KMS audit logs are kept 180d but we need the log-bridge query. Use: `gcloud logging read "resource.type=project AND logName=projects/myproj/logs/cloudaudit.googleapis.com%2Fdata_access" --limit 10000` and filter by key name.
Jess: Will help with owner outreach messaging; prefer a short checklist rather than long forms.
Maria: Good. Two other notes: 1) Found a medium/high vuln in vault-sidecar during vuln-scan (stack trace attached). Need triage before we start deactivations. 2) We should coordinate deactivation windows with on-call.
Aj: Can we pause bulk entitlement removals until vault-sidecar patch lands? I can open an incident timeline and add expected ETA.
ops-bot: Scheduled job created — access-review-runner v2.1 will run snapshots on 2026-02-16T10:00:00Z.
Samir: Patch ETA ~2026-02-15 04:00 UTC, will produce a changelog and mitigation steps. If patch delays, we can do targeted ownerless role removals that don't touch vault bindings.
Maria: Proposed sample for review: (A) 120 ownerless roles (based on last-activity=never) (B) 60 svc-accts with admin-equivalent roles ordered by token issuance count. Thoughts?
Aj: Sounds reasonable. Add a special bucket for keys with cross-project grants. I'll take that.
Jess: Outreach template (short): 1) Do you actively use this role/key? 2) Provide last-used timestamp or link to job. 3) If needed, propose new scoped role. 4) If no reply in 7d, auto-flag for deactivation. I'll post template to the runbook.
Maria: Add an explicit KMS binding proof step: require a recent decrypt/log entry or KMS policy reference. If none, escalate to admin-slimdown.
iam-bot: Reminder: All KMS key actions must be logged to `kms-audit` and include `requesting_principal`.
Samir: For auditability, log the review actions into the `access-review` GCS bucket + append to the internal runbook notes. Also enable CMK rotation alert for keys we touch.
Aj: I'll produce a one-off access snapshot and scrub it for obvious false positives, then post results to #eng-security for quick triage.
Maria: Timeline: owner outreach open 7 days, remediation window 14 days, re-audit 30 days. We'll hold high-risk deactivations until vuln triage confirms no regression.
Jess: I'll start the outreach batch tomorrow morning and tag owners; will use :email: template.
Aj: Pinged IAM squad to confirm role unlink flow and rollback steps.
Samir: I'll take the vuln triage and coordinate with runtime for the vault-sidecar patch validation.
Maria: Perfect. I'll create the tracking doc and assign action items. Link: https://go.redwood/internal/access-review/runbook (please add notes)
Jess: ack :thumbsup:
Aj: posting snapshot in ~30m
ops-bot: Incident created INC-20260214-72 — vault-sidecar vuln triage assigned to Samir.
Maria: Thanks team — no blockers on timeline from my side. If anything changes, update thread.
